---
title: "Data Cleaning"
subtitle: "Preparing raw data for trustworthy analysis"
---

This section highlights projects where the main challenge was improving data quality before analysis or modeling.

## What I Emphasize

- handling missing or inconsistent values
- standardizing formats and categories
- validating assumptions with checks
- documenting each transformation clearly

## Recommended Page Structure

For each project in this section, explain:

1. what was wrong with the original data
2. how you cleaned or reshaped it
3. how you verified the cleaned result
4. why the cleaned data was better for downstream work
